text:
Yesterday at recess was the greatest time ever. My neighbor Sam and I were playing a pretend game. We pretended the jungle gym was a secret island. 

"I am the captain now!" I yelled loudly. 

Sam laughed and scratched his head. "Okay, but we need to find the lost jewel."

We ran around the playground really fast. The wind blew my hair all over my face. We were approaching the water fountain near the swings. Suddenly, a bee started stinging Sam on his arm! He started moaning because it hurt a lot. I didn't have any scissors or medicine to help him.

"We have to go inside right now," I said.

We missed the rest of recess, but the nurse gave Sam a bandage. We didn't find the jewel either, but we still had fun.

The cave looked dark and scary, but we moved closer anyway. I had a bad feeling in my tummy about going inside. My friend Tom was jumping up and down because he was excited. He knew there was gold hidden deep in the rocks.

"This is the most important quest ever," Tom called loudly.

Suddenly, a strange green light appeared from behind a big rock. A groaning sound started echoing, and then a tiny goblin walked out! He was holding a shiny golden thread in his hand.

"You must paid a toll to pass!" the goblin shouted.

I didn't have any money, but I gave him my sandwich. He smiled and disappeared into the shadows. Seeing the path was clear, we kept loading our bags with cool rocks. I was certain we were going to be rich explorers soon.

One day me and my best friend Sam went boating. We saw a long trail in the woods and we got out. It was scary but we had lots of strength. We heard a sound like something trying to gnaw on a bone.

"Did you hear that?" Sam asked me quietly.
"Yes, let’s go look," I said back to him.

We kept walking and the trees were growing tall. Suddenly we saw a wolf roaming around. It looked hungry but then we saw a baby lamb. The wolf was just waiting there. Gradually we threw our sandwiches to the wolf. He ate them and ran away. We spread our arms out and hugged the lamb. We were heroes and we went home happy.

My dog Buster and I went to the park. The sun was hot so we sat under a big tree. Buster started digging in the dirt. He dug a huge hole in the soft earth. I watched him carefully because he gets dirty fast.

Then Buster ran to the water fountain. He was thirsty. "Stop splashing me!" I yelled at him. He barked back like he was laughing. The water sounding like a river. Then my shoe sank into a mud puddle. It was gross. I looked at the swings with yearning. I wanted to play but I was stuck. Everyone at the park looked at my muddy shoe. "Let's go home, Buster," I said sadly. We walked home slowly.

I closed my eyes and gripped my magic wand tight. A scary robot appeared on the playground and it looked mad. It stomped on the ground and blew smoke from its ears.

"Go away right now!" I yelled at the big metal monster.

The robot just laughed and pointed a laser finger at me. I was scared but I drew a circle in the air. Suddenly a bright light flashed and the scene changed fast. My younger brother ran out and gave me a thumbs up.

"You did it! You are earning a hero medal," he shouted.

The robot turned into a tiny toy and fell down. I picked it up with my thumb and put it away. I heard everyone clapping for me because I saved the day.

It was the greatest day for our big soccer game. I was running fast because my dad’s company sponsored our team. We were losing by one goal and time was running out. I gripped the ball with my feet and ran hard. The wind was stinging my face but I didn’t care.

"Pass it to me now!" yelled my friend Sam.

I kicked the ball super hard into the net. We won the game and everyone screamed. We celebrated by dumping the water cooler on our coach. Then we all drank from the water fountain. It was enough fun for the whole week.

"We are the champions!" I shouted to my team.

One day I met a small robot named Zog. He flew down from the sky in a shiny ship. Zog was green and had big eyes. He looked sad and his tummy grumbled loudly.

"Are you hungry?" I asked him.

Zog nodded his metal head fast. "I need batteries for lunch," he said.

I ran inside and grasped two big batteries from my toy car. I gave them to Zog and he ate them up. Suddenly his eyes lit up bright blue. He was so happy that he started singing a beep-bop song. Then he blew a puff of smoke and zoomed away. I hope he comes back soon.

My brain was so tired from math class. We are learning how to multiply by eight. It is super hard and boring. I was just staring at the clock and waiting for the bell. Finally, it rang! We all ran outside because it was recess time.

My neighbor Sam was hanging on the monkey bars. He yelled, "Watch this cool trick!"

But then he slipped and fell in the mud. It was freezing cold outside, so the mud was icy.

"Are you okay?" I asked him.

"Yeah, but my pants are wet," Sam said.

He looked funny, but I didn't laugh. That would be mean. The teacher blew the whistle, and the danger was over. We walked back inside, but Sam was walking like a robot. I hope he doesn't get in trouble for being muddy. I was just happy that math was finished.

I walked to the spooky island in the middle of the river. My dog Buster came too and he is the greatest dog ever. We wanted to find a secret jewel hidden under a rock. Suddenly Buster stopped and kept his legs steady.

"What is the reason you stopped?" I asked him quietly.

Buster started groaning and then he barked at a bush. A little bird was trapped in some old fishing line. The line was going to wrap around its wing. I caught the bird gently and took off the string. Then I sat down and played my guitar for it. The bird grew happy and flew away fast.

"We are like heroes," I told Buster with a big smile.

We never found the jewel but we saved a life. Then we crashed onto the grass and looked at the clouds.

I was exploring the woods behind my house yesterday. I looked at the ground and saw something weird. It was a big red bug with spots. I believed it was a rare beetle. I grabbed a jar and tried to catch it.

"Stay still, little bug," I whispered to it.

But the bug spread its wings and flew up. I feared it was a stinging bug! It landed on a flower, so I tried again. I opened the jar and moved very slow. I didn't want to squeeze it. Just then, my dog Buster appeared. He was bringing me a stick. He barked loud and scared the bug away!

"Oh no, Buster!" I shouted. "You ruined it!"

I am keeping the jar just in case it comes back.

My dog Buster was sleeping on the balcony in the sun. The weather was very hot and nice outside. I thought Buster looked like a big fuzzy rug. Suddenly, a blue bird flew down and started jumping near him.

"Go away bird," I grumbled quietly to myself.

But the bird kept thumping its little feet. Buster woke up and started barking and stamping his paws. He started running in circles and everyone laughed at the scene. He was chasing the bird but it was too fast.

"You are too slow, Buster!" my mom yelled.

The bird looked shiny like a jewel and flew away high. Buster was sad seeing it leaving, so I gave him a treat.

I was jumping up and down because it was race day. My neighbor and his daughter came over to our yard. We drew a line on the ground with a stick. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. 

"Get ready to run fast!" I yelled to everyone.

"I will seize the win today," my friend said.

We played rock paper scissors to see who started first. I put out scissors and I won the start. I took off tearing down the grass. My finger scratched a tree branch but I kept going. I was growing tired but I saw the finish line. I fell on the earth right at the end. I did receive the first place ribbon! It was just a piece of blue paper. I was so happy I won the big race.

I was already late for school and my backpack felt heavy. My math homework was hard and I struggled with it last night. Mom said, "Hurry up or you will miss the bus!" I ran to the kitchen and grabbed my lunchbox fast.

The bus was loading kids when I finally got outside. I sat next to my friend Jake and he was groaning. He said, "I think we have a spelling test today." I felt scared because I did not study my words.

At recess I saw a shiny feather on the ground. I crawled under the slide to seize it before the bell rang. I hope I receive a good grade on the test later. It was a crazy morning but at least I found something cool.

My best friend Sarah had a sleepover for her birthday. We put up a tent in her living room like it was a secret island. We were reading scary stories about a big creature. Suddenly the lights went out and Sarah screamed. 

"Something is wrong!" she yelled. "I am afraid!"

It was dark and freezing in the house. We pretended we were climbing a huge mountain to escape. My dad came in with a flashlight and laughed at us. 

"It just struck midnight, girls," he said. "Happy birthday Sarah!"

We stopped feeling scared and started singing happy birthday. We ate cake in the tent and it tasted really good. I have trained my dog to sing too but he wasn't there. It was the best night ever.

My brother had a sleepover for his tenth birthday. Mom brought pizza and soda to the basement for us. We treated the basement like a jungle gym. We were jumping on the couch and stamping our feet loud.

"Stop making so much noise down there!" Mom yelled.

My friend Jake was hiding behind the big chair. He was pretending to be a scary creature. He wanted some protein so he ate a cheese stick.

Then the lights went out and we got scared. We couldn't find the flashlight either.

"I think we are lost in the dark," Jake whispered.

We were seeing shadows moving on the wall. It was just our cat, but we screamed anyway. Mom came down with a light and laughed at us. It was the best birthday ever.

It was a boring Wednesday and I was boating in the pond. Suddenly a big silver robot appeared on the plain grass. He was the height of my house! I started running but my legs felt heavy. The robot was approaching me very fast. His metal brain was glowing bright green.

"Do you have any protein bars?" the robot asked loudly.

I stopped and looked in my pocket. I discovered an old squished granola bar.

"Yes! Eat this!" I yelled and threw it.

The robot ate it and flew away to a magic island. He was just hungry I guess.

My dog Buster escaped from the backyard yesterday. It was freezing outside so I put on my coat. I grabbed a leash and pretended I was a captain.

"Come back here, you silly sailor!" I screamed.

Buster ran to the park and I chased him. He found a squirrel and barked at it. The squirrel was scared and ran up a big tree. Buster looked like he was loading a cannon to shoot. Then I saw my friend Sarah and her daughter doll.

"Is he being bad again?" Sarah asked me.

"Yes, he thinks he is in a racing league," I said.

We finally caught him near the swings. Sarah gave him a roasted peanut from her pocket. We had a meeting about keeping him safe. Then we walked home and gave Buster a treat.

We had a big sleepover for my birthday last Saturday. My friends and I set up a tent in the living room. Suddenly, my dad appeared with a scary mask on. We all screamed and I gripped my pillow very tight. Then my dad tripped and landed on the floor with a thump. He was groaning because he hurt his toe on the table.

"Are you okay, Dad?" I asked him.

"I think my toe is toasted!" he said funny.

We heard my mom laughing from the kitchen. We discovered she was hiding behind the door the whole time. It was a funny night. Then we ate popcorn and stayed up super late.

One day, a brave knight was walking in a big meadow. He had a shiny sword and he was looking for dragons. Suddenly, a green alien grew out of the ground! The alien had three eyes and big purple scissors for hands.

"Do not eat me!" yelled the knight.

The alien laughed and said, "I just want a haircut."

But then it started raining pink slime from the sky. The alien reached up and caught some slime and chewed it. It was so gross that the knight fainted right there. When he woke up, the alien was gone. He ran home fast.

I was boating in space on my rocket ship. My robot Zog was painting the stars purple. Suddenly we heard a loud boom. A big green alien flew by on a shiny saucer. He looked very scary and I feared him.

"Give me your space candy!" the alien yelled at us.

"No way, it is my lunch!" I shouted back.

My heart was pumping fast. Zog simply pointed his laser finger. Zap! The alien’s engine stopped working. The alien fainted right there in his seat. We were safe but we were totally lost. We flew past a sleeping moon. Seeing home was the best part. I never want to go to space again.

I was playing Mario Kart with my brother and he was winning. My brain was hurting because I wanted to win so bad. I was trembling a little bit. He had an incredible lead and I was way behind. I saw a crumb on my controller and I brushed it off.

"You are going to lose!" my brother shouted at me.

"I will not complain if I lose," I said quietly.

Suddenly I got a blue shell from a mystery box. I threw it and it zoomed through the air fast. It hit him and roasted his car. I drove past him and cleared the finish line first! Everyone cheered for me and I felt so happy.

"Next time I will wrap this game up," he said groaning.

I just smiled because my yearning to win was finally gone. The race was closed and I was the champion.

My birthday party was going to be awesome. I invited fourteen friends to come over for cake. My mom greeted everyone at the door with a smile. We played games in the backyard on the soft ground.

"Who wants to play tug of war?" I shouted loudly.

My friend Sam said, "I have the strength of a champion!"

We pulled the rope hard and my team crashed down. We got up and tried again with more power. Suddenly, my dog Buster ran out and chewed on the rope. He thought he was playing too. My mom laughed and said, "Buster wants some company!"

Later, my grandma gave me a special box with a jewel inside. It was a shiny necklace on a thin thread. I feared I might break it, but I loved it. It was the best birthday ever.

I was sitting in my backyard and a giant metal beetle neared the grass. It was a spaceship! A green alien walked out and he looked sad.

"My ship is broken and I have an important mission," the alien said.

I looked at his ship and saw a wire hanging down. I knew how to fix stuff because I love robots. I connected the red wire to the computer immediately. Then a loud ringing sound started and the engine turned on.

"You saved me and now I can go back to earth!" the captain yelled.

He was actually from Earth but lived on Mars now. It seemed impossible but it was true. I heard my mom cheering for dinner so I ran inside. It was a crazy day and I didn't even get stinging from a bee.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. The weather was dark and cloudy but we kept running. We wanted to find the secret cave. Suddenly we heard a loud growl and felt scared.

"Did you hear that?" Sam whispered to me.

"Yes, but we have to be brave," I said.

We walked carefully and then we discovered a hole. It was the greatest cave ever! Sam grabbed his flashlight and lit up the dark walls. Inside was a big bear but he was just sleeping. We were very hungry so we ate our snacks outside. It was fun teaching Sam how to explore but we ran home fast.

We were camping in the scary woods behind my house. My best friend Leo said it was impossible to find the secret cave. We walked for a long time and crossed a big river. Suddenly I heard a loud noise like a drum beating.

"Did you hear that weird rhythm?" I asked Leo.

Leo started shaking and bumping into me. "I am dreaming about monsters!" he yelled.

We kept walking and saw a dark hole in the rocks. I was seeing everything very clearly because of the moon. We went inside and I used all my strength to move a big rock. Then Leo let out a giant sneeze! A bat flew out and scared us. We ran all the way home very fast. It was the best adventure ever.

I was sitting in class and feeling very bored. Mrs. Jones was speaking about math and it took forever. I was yearning for recess because I wanted to run. My legs felt trapped under my little wooden desk. Suddenly the bell rang and broke the quiet sound.

"Finally we can go outside!" I yelled to Sam.

We ran to the door but Mrs. Jones held up her hand. She said we had to remain in our seats.

"Nobody is leaving until I see your homework," she said.

I looked in my bag and my homework appeared right there. I did my training for soccer so I almost forgot it. I showed her the paper and then we ran outside. We played tag and it was the best recess ever.

It was my nephew Sam’s birthday last Saturday. He turned eight years old and we had a big party. My mom brewed some special tea for the grown-ups. I counted the candles on the cake twice. Then my dad reached for the big knife to cut it. Everyone started singing really loud throughout the whole house. Sam stood up to his full height and smiled.

"I want the biggest piece!" Sam yelled at us.

"You have to wait your turn," I said back.

Then we realized we forgot to buy ice cream. My dad ran to the store while we kept eating cake. I was reading my book until he came back. It was a really fun day for everyone.

We stood in line for recess and my stomach chewed itself. I really wanted to play kickball but the big kids were playing.

"You can join my team," said Sam. "We need a good kicker."

I nodded and we ran to the field. I was nervous as the pitcher neared the mound. He threw the ball fast but I got into a rhythm. I kicked it super hard and it went flying. It was like I was in the major league!

"Run!" screamed Sam while jumping up and down.

I ran to first base and I felt happy. Usually kickball is impossible for me. My confidence grew and I felt like a hero. It was way better than my weekend camping trip. Then the bell rang and recess was over. We walked back inside and I was hanging my head low. But at least I got a home run.

My dog Rex thinks he is a brave knight. He scrambled through the bushes leading to the big woods. I ran after him because I was a little scared. Rex found a big pile of sticks. It looked like a messy wooden castle. Although it was just sticks, Rex barked loudly at it.

"Come back here, Rex!" I shouted.

Rex did not listen and he struggled with a branch. He chewed on the stick instead of guarding me. He is not in the league of super dogs yet.

"You are a silly boy," I told him.

We walked home and Rex wagged his tail happily.

My younger brother Tim and I went on an adventure. We live in a big apartment building. We pretended the hallway was a jungle.

"Look out for the elephant!" I yelled.

Tim ran behind a plant. He is small but he is stronger than he looks. We crossed the dark hall quietly. Suddenly a bad monster jumped out. It was just Mr. Jones's cat but it looked scary.

"Throw the magic rock!" Tim shouted at me.

I threw my bouncy ball and it struck the wall. The cat got scared and ran away fast. We were safe. We went back inside for a snack. It was a good quest.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went to the old woods. We heard a scary groaning noise coming from a big cave. Sam was scared but I knew we had to look. We walked carefully inside the dark hole. It was very cold and wet in there.

"Do you see anything?" Sam whispered to me.

"I see a glowing red eye!" I yelled back.

It was a monster but it was actually just stuck. It had a big rock on its foot. We understood it needed help so we started loading rocks. We threw the rocks away and the monster smiled. It ran away fast. We were heroes and we walked home for dinner.

I was playing a really cool video game called Ninja Jump. My character had to climb up a big mountain. The mountain was surrounding a secret castle. I was doing really well at first.

"You can do it, Jake!" shouted my brother from the couch.

I pressed the jump button, but I pressed it wrong. My ninja missed the ledge and he fell down into the water. It was a huge splash. I felt sad because I lost my last life.

"Next time use the bungee rope!" my brother said.

I stood up and stretched my legs. We had a team meeting about how to win. We decided to try again after lunch. Next time I will get to the top!

I was playing in the big soccer league final today. The other team was huge and they looked mean. My coach yelled, "Pay attention to your surrounding!" I tried to understand his plan but I was scared. The ball dropped right in front of my feet suddenly. I thought about scoring a single goal to win. My imagination went wild and I saw myself holding the trophy. But then a big kid ran at me fast. I was in danger so I kicked the ball hard. It flew past the goalie and hit the net! "We won!" my friend Sam yelled and hugged me tight. The whole scene was crazy and everyone was jumping. We got pizza after the game and it tasted great.

My friends and I went into the spooky woods behind school. We wanted to find the lost cave. My backpack felt like a huge weight on my back. We walked for a long time. Suddenly we heard a noise.

"Did you listen to that sound?" asked Timmy.

It sounded like a baby lamb but we saw nothing. We kept walking and found a big rock. It looked impossible to move. We pushed it together. Behind it was a secret hole!

"This is important for science!" I shouted.

We did not receive any treasure inside. We just found some cool bugs. It was enough fun for one day so we ran home.

I was sitting in class and looking at the clock. It was almost recess and I was yearning to go outside. My teacher Mrs. Miller was talking about the earth and rocks. I knew all about rocks because I collect them. Finally the bell rang and everyone ran to the door.

Outside the wind blew very hard and messy. I saw my friend Billy by the big red slide. He chose to play tag so I ran after him.

"You can't catch me!" Billy yelled very loud.

"Yes I can!" I shouted back and ran faster.

I got thirsty so I went to the water fountain. I drank enough water and then the bell rang again. We had to remain quiet in the hall. Recess was over way too fast today.

I trained all week for the big soccer game. My dog tried to gnaw on my cleats, but I grabbed them first. We climbed into the car and drove to the field. The other team looked huge, but I knew we could win.

"Listen up everyone," the coach yelled loudly. "Just pass the ball and run fast!"

I grasped the goalie gloves tight and stood in the net. A big kid kicked the ball super hard at me. I jumped and blocked it with my chest! It kind of hurt, but I felt pleasure when everyone cheered. Then my friend Sam scored a goal. We crushed the other team five to zero!

"I knew you could do it!" my mom said.

I believed in us too. The referee blew the whistle, and the game was already over. We won the big trophy!

Me and my dog Buster went outside to play. Buster is big and brown and thinks he is a sailor. He ran to the muddy puddle near the big tree.

"No Buster!" I yelled. "That is not water for swimming!"

But unfortunately Buster jumped right in the mud. Splash! He looked like he was painting himself brown. He shook his fur and mud went everywhere. It got all over my finger and my nose.

"You are so messy," I grumbled at him.

Buster started groaning because he wanted to play more. But it was important to go inside for a bath. He looked like he went bungee jumping into a chocolate cake.

"Come on, you silly dog," I said.

We walked home and he left muddy footprints on the grass. Mom is going to be so mad at us.

One day my dog Max and I went to the big meadow. It was sunny but the wind felt freezing. We walked until we cleared the tall grass. Suddenly I heard a loud thumping sound. I was afraid because it sounded like a giant rabbit.

"What is that noise Max?" I asked him quietly.

Max barked and ran towards the trees. I feared he would get lost so I ran too. We found a deer eating some scorched grass. It looked pleased to have company. Then the deer did a huge sneeze!

"Bless you Mr. Deer," I said.

The deer looked at us like we were invisible. It was not scared of us at all. We watched it until the sun started approaching the hills. Then we went home because we were tired.

I searched my backyard for the alien ship. I was thrilled when I saw a big green light. It was coming closer and closer to my treehouse. The ship was approaching very fast!

Bright pink smoke was surrounding the ship. I was yearning to see a real alien. Suddenly, a metal door opened and steam came out.

"Hello human!" shouted a small blue creature.

The smoke cleared and I saw his three eyes. I remembered my camera was in my pocket. My hands were trembling but I took a picture.

"Are you loading your laser gun?" the alien asked.

"No, it is just a camera for meeting you!" I said.

Then the alien smiled and gave me a glowing rock. I ran inside to tell my mom.

It was my birthday and the weather was hot. My mom said I am her best daughter ever. We played outside and pretended we were sailors on a boat. My friend grasped the map to find the treasure.

"Look at this wonderful gold!" I yelled loudly.

"That is incredible!" my friend shouted back at me.

We ran around but gravity made me fall down. My dad had to guide us to the cake inside. It was hard to maintain being quiet because I was excited. We ate chocolate cake and it was so good. Being ten is going to be the best year.

I was sitting in science class and looking at the weird hamster. His name is Mr. Fluff. Suddenly, Mr. Fluff pushed the cage door open and escaped! He ran fast across the floor leading to the door.

"Oh no!" yelled Mrs. Green. "Everyone catch him!"

I grabbed my lunchbox to block him but he was too fast. He ran under my desk and I discovered a hole in the wall. He squeezed through it. I grumbled because I wanted to hold him.

"I can’t believe he fits," said my friend Leo. "He has too much weight!"

We didn't catch him either. It wasn't a pleasure to do homework after that. We just talked about the hamster all day. Maybe he is eating pizza in the cafeteria now.

My nephew and I went exploring outside today. It was raining a little bit so I wore my green sweater. We ran to the big meadow behind my house.

"Look at that bug!" my nephew shouted.

He grabbed a big black beetle from the wet grass. It looked like a tiny tank walking around. I grasped a stick and we poked the dirt. Then we saw a squirrel holding a piece of newspaper. It ran up a tree like it had an important meeting.

"Where is he going?" I asked.

"Maybe to the mountain," my nephew said.

We pretended the dirt pile was a huge mountain. We climbed it until my mom called us for dinner.

Me and my best friend Sam chose to explore the spooky cave. We crawled inside and it was very dark and cold. Suddenly, a big rock fell and we were trapped!

"Oh no, we are stuck!" yelled Sam.

I remembered what my dad taught me about science class. We looked around for a lever or a button. I saw a shiny handle and I decided to seize it. I pulled it hard and counted to three. One, two, three!

The rock moved and we ran out fast. We were late for our soccer schedule. We didn't want either of our moms to worry. We saw a truck dumping dirt nearby. We were happy to have each other's company. Being safe felt good.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the woods. We were looking for pirate gold. Sam had a map but he held it wrong. We walked for a long time and then we saw a cave. 

"Look at that dark hole!" shouted Sam. 

We ran inside but it was scary. Suddenly a big bear stood up! He was huge and he looked mad. I stepped on a bug and crushed it. The bear started stamping his feet. Sam took out his plastic knife to fight. 

"Run away fast!" I yelled to everyone.

We sprinted out of the cave. We ran all the way home without stopping. We were dumping sweat because we were scared. Next time we will go to a different park. We didn't find gold but we are safe now.

My friend Tim and I drew a map to a cave. Tim wrote a big X on a piece of paper. We grabbed our flashlights and ran to the woods. It was dark and scary inside the cave. Tim led the way and I followed him close.

"Look at that weird bug!" I yelled. It was just a tiny gnat flying near the ceiling.

Suddenly we saw a huge door with a cool design. It looked like fire had scorched the wood. I tried to seize the handle but it was stuck. Then a girl jumped out. She was the king’s daughter! She had sharp scissors in her hand.

"You can’t come in here," she said.

I scratched my head and we ran away fast. We did not find treasure but it was fun.

Yesterday was the greatest day ever because it was my birthday. My friends came over for a sleepover and we played pirates in the backyard. I was the captain and my brother was a sailor. We made a ship out of cardboard boxes.

"Look out for the giant squid!" I shouted loudly.

We sprinted across the grass but then gravity pulled me down. I crashed right into the mud and a gnat flew in my nose.

"Are you okay captain?" my friend Sam asked me.

I believed I was hurt but then my mom appeared with cake. Nothing is wrong when there is chocolate cake. I guarantee it was the best party ever. My dad helped guide us inside to eat. We stayed up super late and told ghost stories too.

My friends and I went through the dark spooky woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. Ben had a map but it was ripped.

"I think the gold is near the big rock," said Ben.

We walked slowly and then we heard a loud roar. A giant bear jumped out from the bushes! We were scared and we sprinted very fast away. We ran until we saw a small cave.

"Quick, go inside!" I yelled to everyone.

We hid in the dark and waited quietly. The bear roared again but gradually walked away. We escaped the danger. Inside the cave, gold coins were scattered everywhere on the ground.

Ben grinned at me and said, "We are rich!"

I thought we were lucky. We trained to be explorers and we found it.

We went camping in the scary woods near my house. My brother Ben held the map and he looked brave. But I really feared the big, dark cave ahead.

"Don't go in there!" I screamed loudly at him.

Ben didn't listen and he walked right inside anyway. Suddenly a big bat flew out and screeched at us. I thought it was meaning to bite my nose! We ran away fast and we fell down.

"That was so scary!" Ben yelled.

We treated our scraped knees and went back home. Ben told Mom he sold the map to a ghost. She just laughed at us dumping our gear. We are never going back there again.

My friends and I went into the dark forest today. We wanted to find the old haunted cabin. We walked for a long time and finally reached a big hill. 

"Look at that spooky light!" said my friend Sam. 

We neared the top and saw a blue ghost floating there. It looked like a big cloud with eyes. I was scared but I did not run away. I turned on my flashlight and shined it at the ghost. 

"Go away ghost!" I yelled really loud. 

The ghost did not like the light and it flew away fast. We saw the cabin but it was locked tight. We sat down and ate toasted marshmallows for a snack. We did not learn the ghost's name but it was fun. It was almost fourteen minutes past dinner so we ran home.

One day I went outside to the woods behind my house. The sun was hot and it scorched the dry grass. I saw my dog Buster running near the big oak tree. He greeted me with a loud bark and wagged his tail. We walked deeper into the trees to look for bugs.

"Look at that big spider web!" I screamed loudly.

The web had a cool design and was very shiny. I grasped a stick and poked it a little bit. Then we decided to make a campfire for lunch. We toasted some marshmallows until they were brown. Mine got roasted too much and turned black.

"This tastes like charcoal," I said to Buster.

He didn't care and ate it anyway. Then I used my fingers to comb his fur. We played until the sun went down. It was the best day ever.
